{{Top|leg}}
An '''explosive rocket''' was a small and lethal anti-personnel explosive designed for use with personal weapon systems. This [[Wrist rocket/Legends|wrist rocket]] was designed to detonate a secondary explosive on impact, showering the immediate area with shrapnel. The [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] [[Mira]] was known to use this type of weapon toward the end of the [[Dark Wars]].
